# ghost/code-word

Code Word (F-Droid) Wordle-style word game: start a new puzzle, type a guess, read the guesses made. The per-letter feedback is only a colour (not readable); an agent reads it from a screenshot. Offline, no account.

Deterministic phone automation for the Ghost in the Droid engine. Replays at zero LLM tokens.

## Install

```bash
ghost skill install ghost/code-word
```

## Run

```bash
ghost skill run ghost/code-word new_puzzle --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/code-word guess --device <serial> --param word=<word>
ghost skill run ghost/code-word get_board --device <serial>
```

## Actions

- `new_puzzle`: Start a new word puzzle
- `guess`: Guess the word CRANE
- `get_board`: What have I guessed so far?
